_comment: Agentic sampler spec of one National Compute MI355X node (8 x MI355X, vLLM ROCm, TP8) for a
Kimi-K3.1-Pro async GRPO run at 262k context. Use it with pool.nc-mi355x-agentic-262k.json and
run.agentic-262k.json (one command: yeto run up --config run.json). The checklist and the
measurements behind every value are in docs/KIMI_K31_ASYNC_RL_GUIDE.md section 3.7.
Engine: preset rl-precision (validated end to end with in-place expert reload; its cold weight
load is about 16 min, amd-article loads in about 94 s at the same decode speed but its
log-prob mismatch against the trainer is not measured). R3 forces DCP 1: the KV cache holds
about 2.6M tokens (amd-article 2.8M), so keep max_in_flight x mean trial context <= about 2.1M.
The preset adds --prefix-cache-retention-interval 9216 on this R3 server so a repeated agentic
prefix hits the prefix cache (128k prefix: 0.71 s instead of 7.7 s).
Concurrency: per-stream decode measured 50.6 / 42.2 / 36.8 / about 31 tok/s at 8 / 16 / 24 / 48
streams; max_in_flight 16 keeps a long trial fast enough to finish inside agent_timeout_s.
Weight switch: vLLM switches by drain (no live update): trials still running
min(drain_timeout_s, reload_max_defer_s) after a release is on disk are cancelled and lost, so
keep the trainer's release interval above the p90 trial wall time.
Every value in angle brackets is a site value; the store and sampler_id are filled by the pool.
agentic.setup: replace the documentation address 192.0.2.11 / user sbx with your sandbox host,
and tunnel.listen with the address the sandbox containers reach (the docker bridge of that host);
setup.tasks.ids are examples: your training task ids, or ids_file (a local file of task ids), not both.
Rows: agentic.max_response_len 262144 = max_model_len = the trainer's --seq-len and
--rollout-max-response-len (a row is at most the engine context), so the same values hold with
context compaction on. Compaction is off here; to turn it on add to agentic (the values validated
on this node; context_budget is at most 259298 for this summary turn, 245760 leaves the summary
turn 13538 tokens of headroom):
"compaction": {"context_budget": 245760, "t_comp": 10240, "keep_recent_steps": 2, "max_compactions": 3}
and see docs/KIMI_K31_ASYNC_RL_GUIDE.md section 3.6 (drain cut, wall clock, buffer size).
